<style>

Sing an ending for a song three times. The computer works out which of the site's familiar rhythm patterns and familiar tonal patterns you sang.
Then you write it into the song on the Notation page, and it tells you when the rhythm is right and when the pitches are right.

## The song

You sing an ending for **Unfinished Song #1** from the tune library: its last two bars are empty, over V then I.
The key, the tonality and the meter come from the song.

```{=html}
<div id="sn-song" style="background:#fff;border-radius:6px;overflow-x:auto"></div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="sn-row" hidden>
  <label>Tonality <select id="sn-mode"><option value="">Choose...</option></select></label>
  <label>Key (do) <select id="sn-key"><option value="">Choose...</option></select></label>
  <label>Meter <select id="sn-meter"><option value="">Choose...</option></select></label>
  <label>Tempo (beats per minute) <input type="range" id="sn-tempo" min="50" max="120" value="76"><span id="sn-tempo-v" class="sn-note">76</span></label>
</div>
<div class="sn-note" id="sn-choice"></div>
```

## Sing it three times

Press **Play and sing** once. The song plays three times in a row without stopping. Each time, sing your ending in its
last two bars, where only the chords play. Only those two bars are recorded. Sing every note on a syllable ("da", "la"),
and separate repeated notes.

```{=html}
<div id="sn-sing" class="sn-off">
  <div class="sn-tools">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="sn-mic">Turn on the microphone</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="sn-rec" disabled>&#9679; Play and sing</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="sn-clear">Clear the takes</button>
  </div>
  <div class="sn-level" aria-hidden="true"><i id="sn-level"></i></div>
  <div class="sn-note" id="sn-live"></div>
  <div class="sn-takes" id="sn-takes"></div>
</div>
<div class="sn-note" id="sn-msg" role="status"></div>
```

## What I heard

```{=html}
<div id="sn-result" aria-live="polite"><span class="sn-note">Nothing yet.</span></div>
<div class="sn-tools" id="sn-result-tools" hidden>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="sn-hear">&#9654; Hear what I understood</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="sn-show">Show the answer</button>
</div>
<div class="sn-paper" id="sn-answer" hidden></div>
```

## Notate it

Write what you sang in the song's two empty bars: choose the rhythm patterns, then enter the notes with letters, the computer keys or a MIDI keyboard.
The rhythm and the pitches are checked separately, each confirmed once. Octave does not matter for the pitches.

```{=html}
<div id="sn-confirms" aria-live="polite"></div>
<div class="sn-note" id="sn-wait">Sing three takes first.</div>
<iframe class="sn-frame" id="sn-frame" title="Notation" src="/tools/notation.html?ending=1"></iframe>
```

## How it works

- **Candidates.** Rhythms come from the Rhythm Sequences bank (`apps/rhythms/rhythm-pattern-object.js`), bars of the chosen meter only; any two bars together make a candidate.
  Tonal patterns come from the Tonal Patterns bank (`apps/patterns/pattern-object.js`), the chosen tonality only, as semitones above the tonic, so the key does not change the match.
- **Your three takes** (the song's last two bars, each time round) are put on a sixteenth-note grid. A note counts when two takes agree on it.
  Your tuning drift (up to about a third of a semitone, sharp or flat all the way through) is removed.
- **The match.** Every rhythm is scored by how well its onsets fit yours; the pitches are covered with as few tonal patterns as possible, in whichever octave you used.
  It is lenient: onsets count up to about a third of a beat early or late, a repeated note counts as one pitch of a pattern, a pattern's
  notes count in any octave (5 down to 1 is the pattern 5 1), and held notes over whole beats (half notes) are familiar rhythms.
  A fit needs rhythm 66%, pitches 66% and the takes mostly in agreement. A note a half step out of the key never counts.
  Otherwise you get a warning and a chance to sing again, never a guess.

```{=html}
<script src="/apps/shared/abcjs-basic.js?v=3"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/tonality.js?v=10"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/audio.js?v=10"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/audio-check.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/pitch-detect.js?v=2"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/abc-core.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/abc-events.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/rhythms/rhythm-pattern-object.js?v=2"></script>
<script src="/apps/patterns/pattern-object.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/tunes/tunes-object.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/sing-notate.js?v=3"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/lessons/sections.js?v=1"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); }, S = window.SingNotate;
  // the banks are top-level consts in their scripts, so reach them by bare name
  var RP = rhythmPatternObject, TP = patternObject;
  var TAKES = 3, METERS = ["2/4", "3/4", "4/4", "6/8"], TONICS = ["C", "Db", "D", "Eb", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "Ab", "A", "Bb", "B"];
  var MODE_LABEL = { major: "Major", minor: "Minor", dorian: "Dorian", mixolydian: "Mixolydian", lydian: "Lydian", phrygian: "Phrygian", locrian: "Locrian" };
  var takes = [], result = null, checker = null, mic = null, recording = false, frames = [], ready = false;

  S.modesIn(TP).forEach(function (m) { $("sn-mode").add(new Option(MODE_LABEL[m] || m, m)); });
  TONICS.forEach(function (t) { $("sn-key").add(new Option(t, t)); });
  METERS.forEach(function (m) { $("sn-meter").add(new Option(m, m)); });

  // the song: read from the tune library on every load, so edits to it carry through. Its key, tonality and meter fill the
  // (hidden) choices; its empty bars at the end are where the singer's idea goes.
  var SONG_ID = "unfinished-song-1", SONG = null;
  Object.keys(tunesObject).some(function (c) { return String(tunesObject[c]).split(/\n(?=X:)/).some(function (t) {
    if (new RegExp("%%id\\s+" + SONG_ID + "\\b").test(t)) { SONG = t.trim(); return true; } }); });
  var SONG_EV = SONG ? AbcEvents.fromAbc(SONG) : null;
  if (SONG_EV) {
    var sk = S.parseKey((/^K:\s*(\S+)/m.exec(SONG) || [])[1]), sm = (/^M:\s*(\S+)/m.exec(SONG) || [])[1], sq = /^Q:\s*(?:1\/4\s*=\s*)?(\d+)/m.exec(SONG);
    if (sk) { $("sn-mode").value = sk.mode; $("sn-key").value = sk.tonic; }
    if (sm) { if (![].some.call($("sn-meter").options, function (o) { return o.value === sm; })) $("sn-meter").add(new Option(sm, sm)); $("sn-meter").value = sm; }
    $("sn-tempo").value = sq ? sq[1] : 92;
    // the sung bars: from the last note's bar on (bars of x rests at the end)
    var lastOn = SONG_EV.sounding.filter(function (e) { return e.kind === "note"; }).reduce(function (m, e) { return Math.max(m, e.t_off); }, 0);
    var BQ = S.meterQuarters(sm), SING_FROM = Math.ceil(lastOn / BQ - 1e-6) * BQ, SONG_Q = SONG_EV.quarters;
    ABCJS.renderAbc("sn-song", SONG, { responsive: "resize" });
  } else $("sn-choice").textContent = "Unfinished Song #1 isn't in the tune library.";
  function chosen() {
    var mode = $("sn-mode").value, tonic = $("sn-key").value, meter = $("sn-meter").value;
    return (mode && tonic && meter) ? { mode: mode, tonic: tonic, meter: meter, key: S.keyName(tonic, mode), tempo: +$("sn-tempo").value } : null;
  }
  var cache = null;
  function pools() {
    var c = chosen(); if (!c) return null;
    var sig = c.mode + "|" + c.meter; if (cache && cache.sig === sig) return cache;
    var barQ = S.meterQuarters(c.meter), bars = S.rhythmBars(RP, c.meter);
    return (cache = { sig: sig, barQ: barQ, bars: bars, cands: S.rhythmCandidates(bars, barQ), pats: S.tonalPatterns(TP, c.mode) });
  }
  function onChoice() {
    var c = chosen(), p = pools();
    $("sn-tempo-v").textContent = $("sn-tempo").value;
    $("sn-sing").classList.toggle("sn-off", !c);
    if (c) $("sn-choice").textContent = (MODE_LABEL[c.mode] || c.mode) + " in " + c.tonic + ", " + c.meter + ": " + p.pats.length + " familiar tonal patterns, " + p.bars.length + " familiar rhythm bars.";
    if (takes.length || result) clearTakes();
  }
  ["sn-mode", "sn-key", "sn-meter"].forEach(function (id) { $(id).onchange = onChoice; });
  $("sn-tempo").oninput = function () { $("sn-tempo-v").textContent = this.value; };
  onChoice();

  // ---------- timing: the beat is a quarter, or a dotted quarter in 6/8 ----------
  function timing(c) {
    var compound = c.meter === "6/8", spb = 60 / c.tempo, spq = compound ? spb / 1.5 : spb;
    return { spb: spb, spq: spq, beatsPerBar: compound ? 2 : +c.meter.split("/")[0], compound: compound };
  }

  // ---------- the microphone ----------
  function ensureMic() {
    if (mic) return Promise.resolve(mic);
    var ctx = MusicAudio.ctx();
    mic = PitchDetect.mic({ ctx: ctx, onFrame: function (f) {
      $("sn-level").style.width = Math.min(100, f.rms / 0.3 * 100) + "%";
      $("sn-live").textContent = f.hz > 0 ? f.name + "  " + f.hz.toFixed(0) + " Hz" : "";
      if (recording) frames.push({ t: f.t, hz: f.hz, rms: f.rms });
    }, onError: function (e) { $("sn-msg").textContent = "Microphone: " + e.message; } });
    return mic.start().then(function () { return mic; });
  }
  $("sn-mic").onclick = function () {
    var b = this; MusicAudio.ctx().resume();
    ensureMic().then(function () { b.textContent = "Microphone on"; b.disabled = true; $("sn-rec").disabled = false; })
      .catch(function (e) { $("sn-msg").textContent = "Microphone: " + e.message + " (it needs https or localhost)"; mic = null; });
  };

  function drawTakes() {
    var el = $("sn-takes"); el.innerHTML = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < TAKES; i++) {
      var d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "sn-take" + (takes[i] ? " sn-done" : "");
      d.textContent = takes[i] ? "Take " + (i + 1) + ": " + takes[i].notes.length + " notes" : "Take " + (i + 1) + ": --";
      el.appendChild(d);
    }
    $("sn-rec").textContent = recording ? "Playing..." : takes.length >= TAKES ? "Three times recorded" : "● Play and sing";
    $("sn-rec").disabled = !mic || recording || takes.length >= TAKES;
  }
  function clearTakes() {
    takes = []; result = null; checker = null; $("sn-result").innerHTML = '<span class="sn-note">Nothing yet.</span>';
    $("sn-result-tools").hidden = true; $("sn-answer").hidden = true; $("sn-confirms").innerHTML = ""; $("sn-wait").hidden = false;
    $("sn-msg").textContent = ""; drawTakes();
  }
  $("sn-clear").onclick = clearTakes;

  // ---------- one run: the song three times in a row ----------
  // The song's melody and chords (a bass note and the triad on each chord), and the beat clicked softly. Its empty bars at the end
  // keep their chords; that's where they sing, and each time round only those bars are recorded: the three takes.
  var NAT = { C: 0, D: 2, E: 4, F: 5, G: 7, A: 9, B: 11 };
  function chordMidis(name) {
    var m = /^([A-G])([#b]?)(m(?!aj))?(7)?/.exec(name || ""); if (!m) return null;
    var r = NAT[m[1]] + (m[2] === "#" ? 1 : m[2] === "b" ? -1 : 0), ns = [0, m[3] ? 3 : 4, 7]; if (m[4]) ns.push(10);
    return { root: r, notes: ns };
  }
  $("sn-rec").onclick = function () {
    var c = chosen(); if (!c || recording || !mic || !SONG_EV) return;
    var ctx = MusicAudio.ctx(), T = timing(c), spq = T.spq, songSec = SONG_Q * spq, barQ = BQ;
    ctx.resume().then(function () {
      var start = ctx.currentTime + 0.4, starts = [];
      for (var r = 0; r < TAKES; r++) {
        var s0 = start + r * songSec; starts.push(s0 + SING_FROM * spq);
        SONG_EV.sounding.forEach(function (e) {
          if (e.kind === "note") e.pitches.forEach(function (p) { MusicAudio.noteAt(p.midi, s0 + e.t_on * spq, Math.max(0.1, (e.t_off - e.t_on) * spq * 0.92), 0.28, "piano"); });
        });
        SONG_EV.chords.forEach(function (ch, i) {
          var cm = chordMidis(ch.name); if (!cm) return;
          var end = i + 1 < SONG_EV.chords.length ? SONG_EV.chords[i + 1].t : SONG_Q, t = s0 + ch.t * spq, d = (end - ch.t) * spq * 0.95;
          MusicAudio.noteAt(36 + cm.root, t, d, 0.14, "piano");
          cm.notes.forEach(function (iv) { MusicAudio.noteAt(48 + cm.root + iv, t, d, 0.06, "piano"); });
        });
        for (var q = 0; q < SONG_Q - 1e-6; q += T.spb / spq) MusicAudio.click(s0 + q * spq, Math.abs(q / barQ - Math.round(q / barQ)) < 1e-6);
      }
      frames = []; recording = true; takes = []; drawTakes();
      var singSec = (SONG_Q - SING_FROM) * spq;
      starts.forEach(function (t0, i) {
        setTimeout(function () { $("sn-msg").textContent = "Listen (" + (i + 1) + " of " + TAKES + ")..."; }, Math.max(0, (t0 - SING_FROM * spq - ctx.currentTime) * 1000));
        setTimeout(function () { $("sn-msg").textContent = "Sing the ending! (" + (i + 1) + " of " + TAKES + ")"; }, Math.max(0, (t0 - ctx.currentTime) * 1000));
        setTimeout(function () {
          var notes = S.segmentNotes(frames.filter(function (f) { return f.t >= t0 - 0.3 && f.t <= t0 + singSec + 0.25; }));
          takes.push(S.takeFromNotes(notes, { secPerQuarter: spq, t0: t0 }));
          if (i === TAKES - 1) { recording = false; $("sn-msg").textContent = ""; }
          drawTakes();
          if (takes.length >= TAKES) analyse();
        }, Math.max(0, (t0 + singSec + 0.35 - ctx.currentTime) * 1000));
      });
    });
  };

  // ---------- the match ----------
  function analyse() {
    var c = chosen(), p = pools(); if (!c) return;
    var comb = S.combine(takes, S.parseKey(c.key), { span: p.barQ * 2 });
    var r = S.match(comb, p.cands, p.pats, { beat: S.beatOf(c.meter) }); result = r;
    var el = $("sn-result"); $("sn-answer").hidden = true;
    if (!r.ok) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="sn-warn" role="alert"><strong>I can\'t tell what you sang.</strong> ' + esc(r.message) + '<div class="sn-tools"><button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="sn-again">Sing again</button></div></div>';
      $("sn-again").onclick = clearTakes; $("sn-result-tools").hidden = true; checker = null; $("sn-wait").hidden = false;
      $("sn-wait").textContent = "Sing three good takes first."; return;
    }
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="sn-good"><strong>Found it.</strong> Two bars of ' + esc(c.meter) + ', ' + r.best.notes.length + ' notes (rhythm ' + Math.round(r.best.rhythm * 100) + '%, pitches ' + Math.round(r.best.tonal * 100) +
      '%). Now write it down below. The answer stays hidden until you ask.</div>';
    $("sn-result-tools").hidden = false; $("sn-wait").hidden = true; $("sn-confirms").innerHTML = "";
    checker = S.checker(r.best, S.parseKey(c.key), SING_FROM); sendBlank();
  }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>]/g, function (ch) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;" }[ch]; }); }

  function answerAbc() { var c = chosen(); return S.answerAbc(result.best, { meter: c.meter, key: c.key }); }
  $("sn-show").onclick = function () {
    if (!result || !result.ok) return; var a = $("sn-answer");
    a.hidden = !a.hidden; this.textContent = a.hidden ? "Show the answer" : "Hide the answer";
    if (!a.hidden) ABCJS.renderAbc(a, answerAbc(), { responsive: "resize" });
  };
  $("sn-hear").onclick = function () {
    if (!result || !result.ok) return; var c = chosen(), T = timing(c), k = S.parseKey(c.key), ctx = MusicAudio.ctx();
    ctx.resume().then(function () {
      var t = ctx.currentTime + 0.1;
      result.best.notes.forEach(function (n) { MusicAudio.noteAt(60 + k.pc + n.semis, t + n.q * T.spq, Math.max(0.15, n.dur * T.spq * 0.95), 0.3, "piano"); });
    });
  };

  // ---------- the Notation frame ----------
  var frame = $("sn-frame");
  function sendBlank() {
    var c = chosen(); if (!ready || !c || !result || !result.ok) return;
    frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: "end-load", abc: SONG, title: "Unfinished Song #1: your ending" }, location.origin);
  }
  window.addEventListener("message", function (e) {
    if (e.source !== frame.contentWindow || e.origin !== location.origin || !e.data) return;
    if (e.data.type === "end-ready") { ready = true; sendBlank(); }
    if (e.data.type === "end-change" && typeof e.data.abc === "string" && checker) {
      var u = checker.update(e.data.abc);
      if (u.message) {
        var d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "sn-ok"; d.textContent = u.message + (u.done ? ". You wrote what you sang." : "."); $("sn-confirms").appendChild(d);
      }
    }
  });
  setInterval(function () {
    try { var h = frame.contentDocument.documentElement.scrollHeight; if (h && Math.abs(h - frame.offsetHeight) > 20) frame.style.height = h + "px"; } catch (e) {}
  }, 700);

  drawTakes();
  window.SingNotatePage = { state: function () { return { takes: takes, result: result, chosen: chosen() }; }, setTakes: function (t) { takes = t; drawTakes(); analyse(); } };
})();
</script>
```
